CodeInjector.BodyTopTitle: Code at the top of the body tag
CodeInjector.BodyTopDescription: Injected right after the opening body tag of every Matomo page, before the page content. Wrap your code in script or style tags. The code is not injected on this settings page, so a snippet breaking the interface can always be fixed here.
CodeInjector.BodyBottomTitle: Code at the bottom of the body tag
CodeInjector.BodyBottomDescription: Injected right before the closing body tag of every Matomo page, after the page content. Wrap your code in script or style tags. The code is not injected on this settings page, so a snippet breaking the interface can always be fixed here.
CodeInjector.UnclosedScriptTag: This script tag is never closed, it would swallow the rest of the Matomo page.
CodeInjector.MissingTags: This code is not wrapped in a script or style tag, it will be displayed as text in every page.
